query:
-- Lição 390007: Stock Market Basics
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"stock","translation":"ação","phonetic":"/stɑːk/","example":"I bought some stock in Apple.","synonyms":["share","equity","security"]},
  {"word":"market","translation":"mercado","phonetic":"/ˈmɑːrkɪt/","example":"The stock market is volatile today.","synonyms":["exchange","marketplace","trading floor"]},
  {"word":"invest","translation":"investir","phonetic":"/ɪnˈvɛst/","example":"I want to invest in technology.","synonyms":["put money into","fund","finance"]},
  {"word":"profit","translation":"lucro","phonetic":"/ˈprɑːfɪt/","example":"We made a good profit this quarter.","synonyms":["gain","earnings","return"]},
  {"word":"dividend","translation":"dividendo","phonetic":"/ˈdɪvɪdɛnd/","example":"The company pays quarterly dividends.","synonyms":["payout","distribution","share"]},
  {"word":"portfolio","translation":"portfólio","phonetic":"/pɔːrtˈfoʊlioʊ/","example":"My investment portfolio is diversified.","synonyms":["holdings","assets","investments"]},
  {"word":"risk","translation":"risco","phonetic":"/rɪsk/","example":"Every investment has some risk.","synonyms":["danger","hazard","uncertainty"]},
  {"word":"broker","translation":"corretor","phonetic":"/ˈbroʊkər/","example":"I use an online broker for trading.","synonyms":["agent","dealer","intermediary"]}
]' WHERE id = 390007;

-- Lição 390008: Scientific Research
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"research","translation":"pesquisa","phonetic":"/rɪˈsɜːrtʃ/","example":"Scientific research takes time.","synonyms":["study","investigation","analysis"]},
  {"word":"experiment","translation":"experimento","phonetic":"/ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt/","example":"We conducted a successful experiment.","synonyms":["test","trial","procedure"]},
  {"word":"hypothesis","translation":"hipótese","phonetic":"/haɪˈpɑːθəsɪs/","example":"Our hypothesis was proven correct.","synonyms":["theory","assumption","proposition"]},
  {"word":"data","translation":"dados","phonetic":"/ˈdeɪtə/","example":"We collected valuable data.","synonyms":["information","facts","statistics"]},
  {"word":"analysis","translation":"análise","phonetic":"/əˈnæləsɪs/","example":"The analysis shows interesting results.","synonyms":["examination","study","evaluation"]},
  {"word":"conclusion","translation":"conclusão","phonetic":"/kənˈkluːʒən/","example":"What is your conclusion?","synonyms":["finding","result","inference"]},
  {"word":"laboratory","translation":"laboratório","phonetic":"/ˈlæbrətɔːri/","example":"We work in a modern laboratory.","synonyms":["lab","research facility","testing center"]},
  {"word":"methodology","translation":"metodologia","phonetic":"/ˌmɛθəˈdɑːlədʒi/","example":"Our methodology is rigorous.","synonyms":["approach","system","procedure"]}
]' WHERE id = 390008;

-- Lição 390009: Travel Adventures
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"travel","translation":"viajar","phonetic":"/ˈtrævəl/","example":"I love to travel around the world.","synonyms":["journey","tour","voyage"]},
  {"word":"airport","translation":"aeroporto","phonetic":"/ˈɛrpɔːrt/","example":"We arrived at the airport early.","synonyms":["terminal","airfield","aerodrome"]},
  {"word":"passport","translation":"passaporte","phonetic":"/ˈpæspɔːrt/","example":"Don\'t forget your passport!","synonyms":["travel document","ID","papers"]},
  {"word":"hotel","translation":"hotel","phonetic":"/hoʊˈtɛl/","example":"We booked a nice hotel.","synonyms":["inn","lodge","accommodation"]},
  {"word":"adventure","translation":"aventura","phonetic":"/ədˈvɛntʃər/","example":"This trip was a great adventure!","synonyms":["expedition","journey","quest"]},
  {"word":"tourist","translation":"turista","phonetic":"/ˈtʊrɪst/","example":"Many tourists visit this city.","synonyms":["traveler","visitor","sightseer"]},
  {"word":"destination","translation":"destino","phonetic":"/ˌdɛstɪˈneɪʃən/","example":"Paris is my favorite destination.","synonyms":["place","location","endpoint"]},
  {"word":"luggage","translation":"bagagem","phonetic":"/ˈlʌɡɪdʒ/","example":"Where is my luggage?","synonyms":["baggage","bags","suitcases"]}
]' WHERE id = 390009;

-- Lição 390010: Health and Fitness
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"health","translation":"saúde","phonetic":"/hɛlθ/","example":"Good health is important.","synonyms":["wellness","fitness","wellbeing"]},
  {"word":"exercise","translation":"exercício","phonetic":"/ˈɛksərsaɪz/","example":"I exercise every morning.","synonyms":["workout","training","activity"]},
  {"word":"fitness","translation":"condicionamento físico","phonetic":"/ˈfɪtnəs/","example":"Fitness requires dedication.","synonyms":["health","strength","conditioning"]},
  {"word":"nutrition","translation":"nutrição","phonetic":"/nuːˈtrɪʃən/","example":"Good nutrition is essential.","synonyms":["diet","nourishment","food"]},
  {"word":"gym","translation":"academia","phonetic":"/dʒɪm/","example":"I go to the gym three times a week.","synonyms":["fitness center","health club","workout facility"]},
  {"word":"muscle","translation":"músculo","phonetic":"/ˈmʌsəl/","example":"Exercise builds muscle.","synonyms":["tissue","sinew","strength"]},
  {"word":"energy","translation":"energia","phonetic":"/ˈɛnərdʒi/","example":"I have more energy after exercising.","synonyms":["power","vitality","vigor"]},
  {"word":"healthy","translation":"saudável","phonetic":"/ˈhɛlθi/","example":"Eating vegetables is healthy.","synonyms":["fit","well","wholesome"]}
]' WHERE id = 390010;
